entries.source:
#GOLD#Instant Talents#LAST#
Some activated talents take no time to use, being activated with but a thought.
Unlike most talents, instant talents are never put on cooldown from being stunned, and may be usable when most other talents are not.
Specific information on each talent appears its tooltip.
entries.target:
#GOLD#瞬间技能#LAST#
有些主动技能使用时不消耗时间，一念之间即可发动。
和其他技能不同，瞬间技能不会因震慑而进入冷却状态，并且在大部分技能都不能使用的时候仍有可能使用。
有关技能的详细信息，请参阅技能的提示框。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Ammo remaining#LAST#
This is the amount of ammunition you have left.
Bows and slings must be reloaded when this reaches 0, which you will do automatically each turn you rest or don't perform a non-movement action.
Alchemists use specially prepared gems as ammunition to throw bombs, which must be reloaded manually.
entries.target:
#GOLD#弹药剩余#LAST#
表示你剩余的弹药数量。
弓和投石索在弹药耗尽的时候必须装填；在你休息、原地等待或只进行移动的每个回合，都会自动装填。
炼金术士使用特制的宝石作为投掷炸弹的弹药，必须手动装填。

entries.source: They are a sturdy race and are known for their masterwork, yet they are not well loved, having left other races to fend for themselves in past conflicts.
entries.target: 他们是支强壮的种族，以大师级手艺而闻名，但由于在过去的冲突中任由其他种族自生自灭，他们并不受人喜爱。

entries.source: Blond Beard
entries.target: 金色络腮胡

entries.source: Yet they remain quiet and try to hide their magic from the world, for they remember too well the Spellblaze - and the Spellhunt that followed.
entries.target: 尽管如此，他们仍保持低调，试图向世人隐藏自己的魔法，因为他们对魔法大爆炸及随后发生的魔法狩猎仍记忆犹新。

entries.source: Their affinity for nature and their reclusion have made them great protectors of the natural order, often opposing their Shaloren cousins.
entries.target: 他们长期隐居在自然中，由于和自然的紧密联系，自然精灵成为自然秩序的保护者，也使他们经常与近亲永恒精灵对立。

entries.source: #{italic}#"Giant"#{normal}# is a catch-all term for humanoids which are typically over eight feet in height.  Their origins, cultures, and relationships to other races differ wildly, but they tend to live as refugees and outcasts, shunned by smaller sentient races who usually see them as a threat.
entries.target: #{italic}#"巨人"#{normal}# 是对身高通常超过八英尺的人型生物的统称。巨人各族的起源、文化以及与其他种族的关系千差万别，但他们往往以难民和被排斥者的身份生活，体型较小的智慧种族通常视他们为威胁，对他们避之不及。

entries.source:
Forged in the hatred of ages long passed,
made for a war that they've come to outlast.
Their forgotten birthplace lies deep underground,
its tunnels ruined so it wouldn't be found.
Past burglars have failed, but their data's immortal;
to start, look where halflings once tinkered with portals...
entries.target:
他们铸造于久远年代的仇恨之中，
为一场战争而造，却比那场战争存在得更久。
他们被遗忘的诞生地深埋于地下，
为免被人发现，通往那里的隧道已遭毁坏。
过去的窃贼失败了，但他们的数据将永远保存；
要想找到它们，先去半身人曾经摆弄传送门的地方找找……

entries.source: Inscriptions have granted them magical and physical power far beyond their natural limits, but their dependence on runic magic made them a favored target during the Spellhunt, forcing them to take refuge among the Shalore.
entries.target: 刻印赋予他们远超自然极限的魔法与物理力量，但他们对符文魔法的依赖使他们在魔法狩猎期间成为首要目标，迫使他们到永恒精灵之中寻求庇护。

entries.source: They are like humans in that they can do just about anything they set their minds to, yet they excel at ordering and studying things.
entries.target: 他们和人类一样，只要下定决心，几乎什么都能做到，但他们尤其擅长整理和钻研事物。

entries.source: Humans are split into two categories: the Highers, and the rest. Highers have latent magic in their blood which gives them higher attributes and senses along with a longer life.
entries.target: 人类被分为两个亚种：高等人类和普通人类。高等人类的血脉中潜藏着魔力，使他们拥有更高的属性和更敏锐的感知，寿命也更长。

entries.source: - great poison resistance
entries.target: - 极高的中毒免疫率

entries.source: - special skeleton talents: bone armour, resilient bones, re-assemble
entries.target: - 特殊骷髅技能：骨质盔甲、弹力骨骼、重组

entries.source: One race, one mind, one way. Our oppression shall end, and we shall inherit Eyal. Do not presume we are weak - our way is true, and only those who help us shall see our strength.
entries.target: 一个种族，一种思想，一种道路。我们所受的压迫终将结束，而我们将继承埃亚尔。不要以为我们软弱——我们的道路才是真理，只有帮助我们的人才能见识到我们的力量。

entries.target: 他们天生掌握#GOLD#主导意志#WHITE#技能，使他们能在短时间内控制一个较弱生物的思维。当效果结束时，被控制目标死亡。

entries.source: The known world has been at relative peace for over one hundred years, and people are prospering again.
entries.target: 已知世界已经保持了一百多年的相对和平，人们再次繁荣起来。

entries.source: If so, you will battle your own champion next time!
entries.target: 如果成功，下次挑战竞技场时，你将与自己的冠军角色交战！

entries.source: Pyre
entries.target: 烈火月

entries.source: Decay
entries.target: 凋零月

entries.source: SPEAK UP, HAMBRAIN. I'VE JUST GOTTEN MY EARDRUMS BLOWN OUT BY YET ANOTHER BY-THE-PYRE POTION GONE SOUTH, REMEMBER? THRICE-DAMNED THING WAS GOING PERFECTLY, TOO. TOKNOR'S TACKLE!
entries.target: 说大声点，笨蛋！我的耳膜刚又被一瓶该死的药剂炸破了，记得吗？那该死的东西本来一切顺利！图库纳的命根子！

entries.source: WHICH ELIXIR DO YOU WANT TO HELP ME WITH? YOU ARE HERE TO DO JUST THAT, RIGHT? YOU'RE NOT SOME IMBECILE HERE LOOKING FOR A LOVE POTION?
entries.target: 你想帮我配哪一种药剂？你是来帮忙的吧？你该不会是来求迷情药水的蠢货吧？

entries.source: Oh, easy. You get a swig of each brew, of course. They'll put hair on your chest, and possibly your eyelids and fingernails. And, if your aid proves the deciding factor, then I've got a real treat for you: perhaps the last Taint of Purging left in Maj'Eyal.
entries.target: 很简单，每份佳酿我都会分你一口。喝下这些佳酿会让你长出胸毛，说不定连眼皮和指甲上都会长。而且，要是你的帮助能起决定性作用的话，我还会额外给你一件真正的宝物：也许是马基·埃亚尔仅存的最后一枚“污印：清除”哦。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The dwarf finally returns with a vial and a small pouch.*#WHITE#
I put a bit of the good stuff in this one, though it won't do you any favors tomorrow morning. And careful with that Taint of Purging, especially if the wife answers the door the next time you knock. Har!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那个矮人终于回来了，手里拿着一个药瓶和一个小袋子。*#WHITE#
我往这瓶里加了点好料，不过明早可有你受的。还要当心那枚“污印：清除”，特别是下次你敲门时要是我老婆来开门。哈！

entries.source: Just give me the basics (reveals locked talent category) - 100 gold.
entries.target: 只学习基础（揭示锁定的技能类别）- 100 金币。

entries.source:
My husband, Rashim, is a Sun Paladin. He was sent to clear the spider lair of Ardhungol to the north of this town.
It has been three days now. He should be back by now. I have a feeling something terrible has happened to him. Please find him!
He should have a magical stone given by the Anorithil to create a portal back here, yet he did not use it!
entries.target:
我的丈夫拉希姆是一名太阳骑士。他被派去清理本镇北方的阿尔德胡格蜘蛛巢穴。
如今已经过去三天了。按理说他现在早该回来了。我有一种不祥的预感，他可能遭遇了可怕的不测。求求你帮我找到他！
他身上本该携带着星月术士所赠的魔法石，用来开启返回此地的传送门，可他却一直没有使用！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A tall, hooded man stares at you*#WHITE#
Yes...yes...you look like a promising warrior indeed...
I have an offer, @playerdescriptor.race@.
You see...I am an agent for the Arena. I look for promising warriors that
can provide a good show for our audience. Perhaps you are strong enough to join.
All you need to do is beat three of my men in battle, and you shall be rewarded.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You consider the offer of the mysterious hooded man for a moment*
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个高大、头戴兜帽的男人注视着你*#WHITE#
是的……是的……你的确像是一名很有潜力的战士……
我有个提议，@playerdescriptor.race@。
你看……我是竞技场的招募员，专门寻找有潜力的战士，
为观众献上精彩表演。或许你足够强大，能够加入我们。
你只需在战斗中击败我的三名手下，就能获得奖励。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你思量了片刻这个神秘兜帽人的提议*

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The man lets out a disappointed sigh*#WHITE#
That's unfortunate. We could have used someone like you.
You are just the type the audience likes. You could have been a champion.
Alas, if you stand by your choice, we shall never meet again.
However, if you change your mind...I will #YELLOW#stay in Derth just a little
longer.#WHITE#
If I am still around, we can have a deal. Think about it, @playerdescriptor.race@.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*男人失望地叹了口气*#WHITE#
真遗憾。我们本可以用上你这样的人。
你正是观众喜欢的类型，本可以成为一名冠军。
唉，如果你坚持这个选择，我们就再也不会见面了。
不过，如果你改变主意……我还会#YELLOW#在德斯镇多待
一小段时间。#WHITE#
只要我还在，我们就仍可谈成这笔交易。好好想想吧，@playerdescriptor.race@。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The Cornac rogue comes back from the shadows*#WHITE#
Well done, @playerdescriptor.race@! I knew you had potential.
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The rogue takes off his hood, showing a fairly young, but unmistakably
#LIGHT_GREEN#battle-hardened man.#WHITE#
The name's Rej. I work for the arena to recruit great fighters who can give a
good show... and not die in two blows. You are one of those, indeed!
I won't keep you away from your adventures. I was there too, long ago.
But we can make you a true champion, beloved by many and bathing in diamonds.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you travel back to Derth in company of the rogue, you discuss your
#LIGHT_GREEN#battles in the forest. He provides you with great insight on your combat technique (#WHITE#+2 generic talent points#LIGHT_GREEN#)*
#WHITE#Very well, @playername@. I must go now.
Good luck in your adventures, and come visit us when you are done!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*那名科纳克盗贼从阴影中现身*#WHITE#
干得漂亮，@playerdescriptor.race@！我就知道你有潜力。
#LIGHT_GREEN#*盗贼摘下兜帽，露出一张颇为年轻、
#LIGHT_GREEN#却显然久经战阵的男人面孔。#WHITE#
我叫瑞吉。我为竞技场招募优秀斗士，
他们既要能奉上精彩表演……也不能挨两下就死。你的确就是这种人！
我不会耽误你继续冒险。很久以前，我也曾踏上冒险之路。
但我们能把你培养成真正的冠军，让你受万众爱戴、坐拥无数钻石。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*你与盗贼结伴返回德斯镇，途中谈起自己在森林里的战斗。
#LIGHT_GREEN#他对你的战斗技巧提出了精辟见解（#WHITE#+2 通用技能点#LIGHT_GREEN#）*
#WHITE#好了，@playername@。我现在该走了。
祝你冒险顺利，等冒险结束后记得来找我们！

entries.source: her
entries.target: 她的

entries.source:
Wait, @playername@, you seem to be quite the adventurer. Maybe we can help one another.
You see, I #{bold}#LOOOVVVEEEE#{normal}# learning new lore and finding old artifacts of power, but I am not exactly an adventurer and I would surely get killed out there.
So take this orb (#LIGHT_GREEN#*she gives you an orb of scrying*#WHITE#). You can use it to talk to me from anywhere in the world! This way you can show me your new shiny findings!
I get to see many interesting things, and you get to know what your items do. We both win! Isn't it sweet?
Oh yes, the orb will also identify mundane items for you, as long as you carry it.
entries.target:
等等，@playername@，你看起来是个相当了不起的冒险家。也许我们能互相帮助。
你看，我#{bold}#超——喜欢#{normal}#学习新的传说知识、搜寻古老强大的神器，但我自己可算不上什么冒险家，到外头去肯定会送命的。
所以拿着这颗水晶球吧（#LIGHT_GREEN#*她递给你一颗鉴定水晶球*#WHITE#）。你可以在世界上的任何地方用它与我通话！这样你就能随时向我展示你新找到的闪亮宝贝了！
我能见识到许多有趣的事物，而你也能弄清楚物品的用途。我们双赢！这不是两全其美吗？
而且，只要你随身携带，这颗水晶球还会为你自动鉴定普通物品。

entries.source: I am back from the Charred Scar, where the orcs took the staff.
entries.target: 我从灼烧之痕回来了，兽人把法杖带到了那里。

entries.source:
The news has indeed reached me. I could scarce believe it, so long have we been at war with the Pride.
Now they are dead? At the hands of just one @playerdescriptor.race@? Truly I am amazed by your power.
While you were busy bringing an end to the orcs, we managed to discover some parts of the truth from a captive orc.
He talked about the shield protecting the High Peak. It seems to be controlled by "orbs of command" which the masters of the Prides had in their possession.
He also said the only way to enter the peak and de-activate the shield is through the "slime tunnels", located somewhere in one of the Prides, probably Grushnak.
entries.target:
我的确已经得到了消息，真令人难以置信，我们和兽人已经战斗得太久了。
他们现在都死了么？仅凭一个 @playerdescriptor.race@ 的力量？你的力量真让我惊叹。
当你忙于解决那些兽人的时候，我们设法从那个兽人俘虏那里获得了一些线索。
他提起了有关巅峰保护罩的事。似乎那个护罩是受“指令水晶球”操控的，那些指令水晶球就在兽人各大部落首领的手中。
他还说想要进入巅峰并关闭护罩的唯一通道是“史莱姆通道”，位于某一个兽人部落内，有可能是格鲁希纳克的部落。

entries.source:
I have already sent parties to clear out the remainder of the prides as you progressed, and have instructed to keep a sharp eye out for any orbs of command you may have missed.
	Which do you not have? I can check with the parties if they found any. Our sources indicate that you should have four: one of Undeath, one of Destruction, one of Dragons, and one of Elemental might.
entries.target:
我们已经派出部队，清理那些被你所击溃的部落的残军。我命令他们仔细搜查，留意任何你可能遗漏的指令水晶球。
	你缺少了什么水晶球？我会去问问他们，看看他们有没有找到。根据我们得到的情报，你应该有四颗指令水晶球：亡灵水晶球，毁灭水晶球，巨龙水晶球，元素水晶球。

entries.source: Limmir's Amulet of the Moon
entries.target: 利米尔的月亮项链

entries.source: So you can infuse amulets in this place?
entries.target: 这么说，你能在这里给项链附魔了？

entries.source: organizing my inventory, I came across some #YELLOW#Smelly Toxin#LAST# that a colleague claimed could actually turn creatures to stone.  Truly exotic!
entries.target: 整理货物时，我偶然发现了一些#YELLOW#恶臭毒素#LAST#，一位同行声称它竟然能将生物石化。真是奇特！

entries.source: I can indeed offer some martial training (talent category Technique/Combat-training) for a fee of 50 gold pieces; or the basic usage of bows and slings (Shoot talent) for 8 gold pieces.
entries.target: 我的确可以为你提供战斗训练（格斗/战斗训练系），你需要花费50金币，或者可以学习使用弓和投石索（射击天赋），花费8金币。

entries.source: I do not have time to talk. This ritual is intense, and we are not alone here. Stop them!
entries.target: 我没时间和你说话。这个仪式非常耗神，而且这里不止我们，拦住他们！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Ben lies defeated at your feet*#WHITE#
T...thank you for... *cough*... saving me from the curse.
I did no... not want for this to...
#LIGHT_GREEN#*he coughs one last time and dies, a smile on his face as his curse is gone.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*本倒在你的脚下。*#WHITE#
谢……谢谢你……*咳嗽*……救我摆脱了诅咒。
我不……不想让事情变成……
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他最后咳嗽一声，含笑死去，诅咒终于消散。*#WHITE#

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two of you spend some time relaxing on the beach.
The air is fresh, the sand shimmers, and the surf roars softly.*#WHITE#

This was such a lovely idea!
I have had a wonderful time with you today.

#LIGHT_GREEN#*She looks longingly into your eyes.*#WHITE#
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你们两个在沙滩上放松了一阵子。
空气清新，沙滩闪闪发光，海浪发出轻柔的涛声。*#WHITE#

来海边真是个好主意！
今天和你玩得很开心啊。

#LIGHT_GREEN#*她含情脉脉地凝视着你。*#WHITE#

entries.source:
You have reached your maximum number of inscriptions (infusions/runes).
If you have unassigned #{bold}#talent category points#{normal}# you can use one to create a new slot (up to 5).
You can replace an existing one or cancel.
The old inscription will be lost.
entries.target:
你的刻印（纹身/符文）数量已经达到上限。
如果你还有未分配的#{bold}#技能树解锁点#{normal}#，可以花费 1 个来创建新刻印位（最多 5 个）。
你可以替换一个现有刻印，也可以取消。
旧刻印将会消失。

entries.source: Very well. There is no hurry. But I will need to spend a number of days studying it before we can create your portal.
entries.target: 好吧，不用着急。不过，要创造你需要的传送门，我还得先花上几天研究它。

@playername@, you are called to serve. The nearby unhallowed morass inhabitants are growing restless.
You must go there and find the source.
entries.target:
@playername@，你效力的时候到了。附近混沌之沼中的居民正在蠢蠢欲动。
你必须去那里，找到这一切的源头。

entries.target: 如果你没有使用肮脏的奥术魔法，那就不用害怕他们。否则的话：去死吧！

entries.target: 隐藏的营地

entries.target: 宁静的草地

entries.target: 这顶由纯粹火焰所打造的王冠上漂浮着许多小小的熔融石块，每一块都可以取下，当作一颗真正的陨石投掷出去。

entries.target: 恶魔空间轨道平台

entries.source: You have survived the onslaught of undead. You notice a way to climb up you had not seen before in a wall nearby.

entries.source: As you walk into the area you notice a huge thunderstorm over your head. Beware!

entries.source: It's a large white ant. The air is frigid around it.
entries.target: 一只巨大的白色蚂蚁，它四周的空气寒冷刺骨。

entries.source: Queen of the ants, queen of the biting death!
entries.target: 蚁群之后，掌控死亡之啮的女王！

entries.source: A large and muscled wolf from the northern wastes. Its breath is cold and icy, and its fur coated in frost.
entries.target: 一头来自北部荒野、体型巨大且肌肉发达的狼。它呼吸冰冷，毛覆寒霜。

entries.source: It is a large wolf with eyes full of cunning, thrice the size of a normal warg.
entries.target: 一只体型巨大的狼，眼中满是狡黠，体型是普通座狼的三倍。
